subject.title: feat: Control UI debug mode — ephemeral connection logs and error details

question: What pre-auth Control UI connection diagnostic content may be shown and copied by users before authentication succeeds?
rationale: The feature is useful for setup recovery, but it crosses auth/device-identity and support-copy boundaries where raw frames could leak sensitive details.

options.title: Redacted phase log
options.body: Expose lifecycle phases, timings, close codes, stable error codes, and sanitized recovery hints while redacting tokens, signatures, device fingerprints, raw headers, and endpoint secrets.

options.title: Post-auth only
options.body: Keep pre-auth UI limited to current recovery messages and improve only the connected Debug page and `logs.tail` experience.

options.title: Raw diagnostic export
options.body: Allow raw frame export behind an explicit advanced warning, accepting higher support value with higher sensitive-data risk.

recommendation.title: Redacted phase log
recommendation.body: Expose lifecycle phases, timings, close codes, stable error codes, and sanitized recovery hints while redacting tokens, signatures, device fingerprints, raw headers, and endpoint secrets.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history in the Control UI Gateway client and Debug page wiring that would host the decision.
